# Urban Edge Properties Signs National Brand For The Outlets at Montehiedra


July 30, 2026 CityBiz


Body


[Urban Edge Properties](https://www.uedge.com/) (NYSE:UE) has announced that a new national brand will be joining the line-up at[The Outlets at Montehiedra](https://www.montehiedratowncenter.com/) , located in San Juan, Puerto Rico.[Coach](https://www.coach.com/shop/women/view-all?ogmap=SEM%7CRTN%7CGOOG%7CSTND%7Cc%7CSITEWIDE%7CRetail%7CCoach_RTL_Google_Text_Signal_NA_Brand_National_Exact_CEO_BAU%7CSitewide_Regular_CEO_CEO%7Ccoach%7C232810164%7C17537984124%7CUS&utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=Coach_RTL_Google_Text_Signal_NA_Brand_National_Exact_CEO_BAU&utm_id=go_cmp-232810164_adg-17537984124_ad-798242461176_kwd-14915810_dev-c_ext-_prd-_sig-Cj0KCQjwkrzPBhCqARIsAJN460nDDZPsweW2YQ4A2f9dtvIatrf4iwlNChtXlDTwkmvfTFuZPjvKcDMaAswjEALw_wcB&keyword=coach&gclsrc=aw.ds&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=232810164&gbraid=0AAAAAD_i1XT4q-vu2oqclU76-ue7-xB4N&gclid=Cj0KCQjwkrzPBhCqARIsAJN460nDDZPsweW2YQ4A2f9dtvIatrf4iwlNChtXlDTwkmvfTFuZPjvKcDMaAswjEALw_wcB) has signed a long-term lease and aims to open later this year.
